focus_areas: Red patch boundaries on white coat
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the transition zones where the long ear hair meets the grass background, as this is a common failure point for generative models. Verify that the red patches on the white coat have natural, organic boundaries rather than sharp, painted-on edges. Ensure the paws are distinct and not merging with the grass texture. Specifically confirm the tail appears docked (short) rather than just hidden.
image_description: A full-body profile shot of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel variety) standing on a green grass lawn. The dog features the characteristic rich chestnut-red and white parti-color coat, long feathered ears, and a docked tail carried level with the back.
